title: Gemini can now choose which moments of a video to inspect
friendlyTitle: Gemini can look more closely at the useful parts of a video
summary: Google added agentic video understanding to Gemini 3.7 Flash, 3.6 Flash and 3.5 Flash-Lite. Instead of sampling an entire video at a fixed rate, the models can search and rescan relevant visual, audio and transcript segments; Google reports up to 88% fewer tokens, 66% lower analysis costs and 7% higher accuracy in its tests.
friendlySummary: Gemini no longer has to inspect every video in the same fixed way. It can search for the important moments and look again when it needs more detail.
whyItMatters: Long recordings, training videos and inspections become more practical to search when the model can focus its attention. Developers can enable the mode in the Gemini API, but should validate rare events and fast action against their own footage.
friendlyWhyItMatters: This could make long videos cheaper and easier to search. Important answers should still be checked against the original recording.
